configurations.//: `npm run dev` starts BOTH halves — the API and Vite — from one command. The harness injects PORT for the port it waits on (5173); the API answers to API_PORT so it can never bind that one too. Without it the app loads and every request in it 502s. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is unset because an agent shell exports one; it wins AI provider resolution and is not usable this way, so every AI call fails through it instead of reaching the configured provider.
configurations.name: ipropy
runtimeArgs: env -u ANTHROPIC_API_KEY API_PORT=4000 npm run dev

configurations.//: Reads live from the CRM API, so start the `ipropy` configuration first or every page renders empty. PORT is pinned because Next.js honours it and the CRM's CORS/APP_URL expects the site on 3000. The folder is found relative to the CRM checkout rather than written out, so this works on any machine and any username.
configurations.name: ipropy-website
runtimeArgs: d="$(cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)/.." && pwd)/ipropy-website"; if [ ! -d "$d" ]; then echo "The website folder is not next to the CRM folder. Clone it: git clone https://github.com/RishabhSinghla/ipropy-website.git"; exit 1; fi; cd "$d" && PORT=3000 npm run dev
